_note: English epilogue narration (DAT2/EDB*.BIZ), one paragraph per unique page, read row by row (column 0 rows 0-4, then column 1). Draft translation from the baked Japanese; the last words of a few pages were hard to read, marked review. Aliases point duplicate pages at the same text.

pages.EDB01: Raizo was defeated, and Batsu's mother was rescued safely. At last, peace came to Taiyo Academy. But Kyosuke knew that as long as he did not defeat his own brother, the danger would never end. Once, he might have hesitated. But shielding his brother now would be nothing but hypocrisy. Defeating him and saving him: only Kyosuke could do both. That resolve would never waver again...
pages.EDB02: Raizo was defeated, and Batsu's mother was rescued safely. At last, peace came to Taiyo Academy. But Batsu had noticed a sad light in Raizo's eyes as they fought. Raizo was the only one who could cure his mother's illness. Until he defeated the huge shadow lurking behind Raizo, there would be no peace for Batsu...
pages.EDB03: Raizo was defeated, and Batsu's mother was rescued safely. At last, peace came to Taiyo Academy. Yet no true smiles could be seen on the students. Everyone seemed to be afraid of some bottomless dread. Only Hinata showed no fear. Whatever happened, she would never lose. For herself, and for the people she loved...
pages.EDB04: Raizo was defeated, and the three headed home together. At last, peace came to Gorin High as well. But for Shoma, true peace did not come. His brother, attacked at the academy and wounded, had taken a turn for the worse. The doctors only tilted their heads, but Shoma understood. His brother was telling him there was a real enemy out there. I'll protect my brother. He was no longer someone to look up to, but his own precious brother...
pages.EDB05: Raizo was defeated, and the three headed home together. At last, peace came to Gorin High as well. But Natsu was not satisfied. In a serious fight you feel a warmth, a meeting of hearts with your opponent. The fight with Raizo had none of that feeling. Natsu was certain. This match is not over yet. It hasn't even begun...
pages.EDB06: Raizo was defeated, and the three headed home together. At last, peace came to Gorin High as well. But Roberto could see it: a shadow of worry crossing the faces of his dear friends, and the next fight waiting beyond. Even if he were left unable to fight again, he would never regret it. Soccer cannot replace his friends' smiles...
pages.EDB07: Raizo was defeated, and the three were told they could return to America. But Roy looked troubled. The message ended by saying Justice Academy might not have fallen after all. The homecoming he had wished for so much. But inside, Japan was no longer a country he disliked. A friendship forged in battle, beyond borders. As he tore up the message, Roy's face showed a smile and fighting spirit.
pages.EDB08: Raizo was defeated, and the three were told they could return to America. But Tiffany hesitated. The message ended by saying Justice Academy might not have fallen after all. She had longed to see Papa and Mama. At Papa's side she could have anything done for her. But none of that mattered anymore. Not what could be done for her, but what she could do. Thinking of Roy and her friends in Japan, the girl she had been was gone...
pages.EDB09: Raizo was defeated, and the three were told they could return to America. The message ended by saying Justice Academy might not have fallen after all. But Boman was sure of it. At first he had thought Japan a strange country without faith. But among the Japanese there did flow a feeling for one's neighbor. When he realized it, Japan was no longer a land of strangers. Boman prayed quietly. Lord, forgive me for fighting once more for my beloved neighbors...
pages.EDB10: Raizo was defeated, but the Top Boss could not be found. Gedo High was as rowdy as ever. Justice Academy seemed to have nothing to do with this school. And Edge thought: if everyone believed the Boss was dead, he would become the Top Boss himself. But his heart said otherwise, and he kept thinking of ways to rescue the Boss. He couldn't leave a buddy in trouble. At last, perhaps, Edge had started down the road to becoming a true Top Boss...
pages.EDB11: Raizo was defeated, but Akira's brother could not be found. How long would he have to search before finding him? The old Akira might have given up, assuming his brother was dead. But now it was different. He had buddies, sharp-tongued but warm-hearted. As long as they were with him, he would never lose heart...
pages.EDB12: Raizo was defeated, but the Top Boss could not be found. Gedo High was as rowdy as ever. Justice Academy seemed to have nothing to do with this school. Gan, as before, was pestered nonstop with requests to help in fights. But he no longer agreed so lightly. For his precious buddy's sake, he would bring the Top Boss back. In his firm declaration, the figure of the Top Boss seemed to overlap with his own...
pages.EDB13: Raizo was defeated, and the people of Justice Academy were freed from the brainwashing and came to their senses. The police began investigating the school, and Raizo, the mastermind, was arrested. But Hideo knew: the true mastermind was not Raizo. After the brainwashing incident, the student council president had vanished without a trace. Through the fighting, the students had taught him true courage. Now it was his turn to be their strength...
pages.EDB14: Raizo was defeated, and the people of Justice Academy were freed from the brainwashing and came to their senses. The police began investigating the school, and Raizo, the mastermind, was arrested. But Kyoko was certain that his arrest was only the tip of the iceberg. She would never again let Japan be put in danger. Though the country had once seemed so hopeless, now, somehow, it was very dear to her. Because the clear eyes of the fighting students had made her realize those feelings...
pages.EDB18: Raizo was defeated, and the students who had been abducted were freed from the brainwashing and returned to their own schools. Peace came to the schools across the country, and the students' faces brightened. But Sakura was thinking. The sense of accomplishment you feel when you beat someone strong: she had not felt it in the fight with Raizo. Danger would come again. Sure of that, she threw herself into special training, her figure showing the pride of a street fighter.
